taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA H7 | Benign Leukocytosis & Leukemias.

words.clue: Elevated white blood cell count above 11 × 10⁹/L
Low white blood cell count below 4.0 × 10⁹/L
Movement of neutrophils from marginating pool to circulating blood
Reactive leucocytosis with left shift mimicking chronic myeloid leukaemia
Most abundant white blood cell type comprising 50-70% of differential count
Gram-positive or gram-negative organism triggering G-CSF release and neutrophilia
Signaling molecule such as G-CSF or IL-8 released during bacterial infection
Corticosteroid drug that impairs neutrophil margination and apoptosis
Red blood cell destruction that can trigger leukaemoid reaction
